description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that records gameplay as state and re-renders it to video inside the client. Works with VulkanMod.

mods.name: Momenton
mods.description: Records gameplay as state rather than pixels, then re-renders it into video inside the client. Recording, editing and export without external software.

releases.notes:
First public build of Momenton for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Records gameplay as state (packets, camera, UI) instead of pixels, plays it back, and exports it to video inside the client.

Requirements: Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API, Java 21. Video export needs ffmpeg.

- F9: start and stop recording
- F10 or the Replays button on the title screen: replay browser

Early release. Works with VulkanMod; under VulkanMod, export runs at the window size and hardware encoders are off. See TASKS.md for what is verified so far.

Licensed GPL-3.0-only. Parts of the export code are adapted from ReplayMod (GPL-3.0).
